answer: Require each earning identity to prove it lives in a distinct network neighbourhood: at random times it must answer latency probes from landmarks spread like a canyon trail, a meadow relay and a gale-exposed coastal node, with round-trip times consistent with only one physical location. Identities sharing a datacentre or ASN collapse to a single slot and share one payout, so a farm must rent genuinely dispersed machines and bandwidth for every fake identity, turning cheap duplication into a linear infrastructure bill.
